name: Hormel Foods
description: Hormel makes and sells branded meat, protein and snack products (SPAM, Jennie-O turkey, Hormel Natural Choice and Black Label, Applegate, Planters, Skippy, Columbus and the MegaMex joint venture) to US retailers, foodservice operators and international customers. About 62 percent of sales are Retail and 33 percent Foodservice; Walmart is about 16 percent of consolidated gross sales less returns. Earnings swing with pork, turkey and other commodity costs and with write-downs: fiscal 2025 operating income fell 33 percent after a $164M non-cash impairment of a minority investment in Indonesia and other charges. It has paid dividends for 392 consecutive quarters.

businessLines.description: Branded protein and food products sold in US grocery, mass, club, natural, drug, dollar and e-commerce channels; includes the MegaMex Foods joint venture.

businessLines.description: Products for distributors and operators in restaurants, hospitality, healthcare, K-12, colleges and convenience stores in the US.
